releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Add the courier-egm-loop skill: EGM rounds on the skill until none is found by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/499
* A session's own check-in, firing after it reported, does not make it owe a new report by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/507
* courier_stop tells the parent of an idle target that still owed a report by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/509
* Model-facing string corrections from the EGM review (#502-#506) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/508
* Skill: where a change goes below the root; laterText cancels at the last report (#513, #515) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/516
* courier-egm-loop: run every round without the owner by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/519
* courier_stop tells the parent of an idle blocked target; only a check-in scheduled before the report is exempt (#512, #514) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/517
* A reported child stops counting while its turn finishes; the limit refusals say what still counts (#511) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/518
* The child brief says the person's words are the person's word (#520) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/521
* The blocked stop notice says the session still holds back its join group (#523) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/529
* A child's status-less message after its parent reported is not a prompt; the reference names the exempt self-scheduled message (#528, #527) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/530
* A blocked child counts toward the limits; the refusals say what counts (#524, #525, #526) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/531
* Real-model rows after EGM loop rounds 1 and 2; relax the fault checker's ordering; measured SUITE weights by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/532
* The limit refusals say to answer a blocked child first (#534) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/535
* The limit refusals say courier_cleanup drops a blocked child (#537) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/538
* courier_cleanup says a kept worktree's session is dropped only by a second call (#540) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/541
* Real-model tables hold one batch; CLAUDE.md drops the exception for old rows by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/543
* The e2e checks wait on conditions, not fixed times by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/542
* recursive-finding: no session touches the wait files; a half started with the finding counts by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/544
* recursive-finding's row covers both file-wait batches by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/545
* Release 0.16.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/546


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0

## What's Changed
* Correct the drift an EGM review found in plugin-api-notes.md by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/458
* Reorganize plugin-api-notes.md and cut history from the maintainer docs by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/459
* Warn any parent with uncommitted work when it spawns an isolated child by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/468
* Say in the failure notice when a failed session still has live sessions under it by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/469
* Give an OpenCode subagent inside a tree no root role line and no courier_spawn by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/470
* Release a group when the parent's turn ended on a plain decline by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/471
* Model-facing strings: five corrections from the skill review (#466) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/473
* Let only the top session write a tree's lesson by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/472
* Add the real-model rows for the EGM fixes on main by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/474
* Shrink courier-orchestrate to what no other text says by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/475
* Add the real-model rows for the relays and a part that goes wrong by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/483
* Tell a sub-orchestrator its children's asks go to the top by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/484
* Tell a session with none of its own running that no report will wake it at maxTotal by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/485
* Real-model smoke test: drop the prompts' sleeps; score a model-chosen native child by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/486
* Docs state how things are now: add the no-history rule to CLAUDE.md by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/487
* Say the model cancels its courier_later check-in; a report does not by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/488
* Have a sub-orchestrator pass a finding or the person's words up to its own parent by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/489
* Skill: say what a parent does with a partial or failed report; wording in the skill, silentNotice and the reference by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/490
* Add the no-sleeps real-model rows after the re-check waves by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/491
* e2e: absence checks wait for a barrier, never a timeout; shard weights re-measured by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/494
* A group's release does not make a child that already reported owe a new report by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/493
* Docs: opencode run waits on a native child still running at the root's end by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/496
* Release 0.15.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/497


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0

## What's Changed
* Find the project id to seed under through a session by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/437
* Show OpenCode's subagents in courier_tree, the panel, courier_stop and the record by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/439
* Strip comments down to one-line OpenCode and host facts by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/440
* Enable the Elephant-Goldfish Model plugin for Claude Code by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/441
* Fix the small drift two EGM reviews found in architecture.md by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/446
* Correct four claims in architecture.md the code does not bear out by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/447
* Correct the drift an EGM review found in docs/reference.md by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/450
* Remove the webhook receiver and courier_subscribe by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/452
* Say in the skill that a failed turn does not count toward the limits by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/451
* Move the plugin API pin from 2.2.5 to 2.2.6 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/454
* Register the skill at skill://courier-orchestrate/SKILL.md by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/456
* Release 0.14.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/457


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.13.8...v0.14.0

## What's Changed
* Document the stage-only npm token by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/430
* Cut courier-orchestrate down to the tools' mechanics by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/433
* Add the review scenario to the real-model smoke test by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/434
* Add the recursive rows for the cut-down skill by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/435
* Release 0.13.8 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/436


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.13.7...v0.13.8

## What's Changed
* plugin-api-notes: record why courier_later does not use OpenCode's schedules by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/423
* Document that /goal does not wait for courier children's reports by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/425
* Remind a child about to go idle without a report, through the experimental.idle hook by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/424
* Link the upstream /goal request from the docs by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/427
* Release 0.13.7 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/428
* Move the plugin API pin to OpenCode 2.2.5 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/429


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.13.6...v0.13.7

issues.title: Evaluate the tree records on a real model: does an orchestrator read them, and does its split change?
Memory for orchestration: a record per tree, a lesson per tree, and a view in the terminal
Relay a child's question (ask tool) to its parent, and the answer back
A renamed or unarchived idle child reads as running: other updates bump time.updated too
Memory: the recorded split line keeps its markdown, is clipped mid-word, and never shows a revised plan
Digby: a pixel from a finished report lingers into the idle animation
